categories_20.description: Rent, mortgage, renter's insurance, and other recurring costs of keeping a place to live.
Electricity, water, gas, internet, and other household service bills.
Supermarket, convenience store, and other purchases of food and staples prepared at home.
Restaurants, cafes, bars, takeout, food delivery, and campus dining spending.
Gas, public transit, rideshare, parking, tolls, car payments, and vehicle maintenance.
Pharmacy purchases, doctor visits, health insurance, therapy, and other medical costs.
Gym memberships, fitness classes, sports gear, and other wellness-focused spending.
Tuition, textbooks, school supplies, and academic software or course fees.
Apparel, shoes, jewelry, and watches bought from stores or online retailers.
Online marketplace orders, electronics, home goods, and other miscellaneous retail purchases.
Concerts, movies, games, events, hobbies, and other leisure activities.
Recurring digital services such as streaming, apps, and AI tools billed monthly or annually.
Haircuts, cosmetics, salon visits, and similar grooming or self-care services.
Flights, hotels, vacation rentals, and other expenses for trips away from home.
Presents for others and charitable contributions.
Bank fees, phone plans, non-health insurance premiums, and other required service charges.
Transfers to brokerage, retirement, or savings accounts, which are not true spending.
Credit card payments, student loans, and other payments toward money owed.
Venmo, Zelle, and cash sent to friends or family, plus transfers between your own accounts.
Paychecks, side income, interest, returns, and reimbursements deposited into the account.
